_comment: Curated one-line purposes for tables whose schema has no comment yet. Keys use the manual's neutral table names. A schema comment always wins; delete an entry here once the table has its own comment.
activity_events: Cross-cutting project and company timeline: who did what, to which record, with a summary and metadata. Written through recordActivityEvent.
agent_items: Items the AI assistant created or tracks for a user (notes, follow-ups).
agent_memories: Long-term memories the assistant keeps per user.
buildertrend_module_attestations: Legacy import: per-module confirmation that a job's legacy data was fully captured.
buildertrend_staging_access_candidates: Legacy import: people found in the legacy system who may need Compass access.
buildertrend_staging_files: Legacy import: archived files captured from the legacy system, with Drive pointers.
buildertrend_staging_identity_decisions: Legacy import: reviewed decisions matching legacy identities to Compass contacts and users.
buildertrend_staging_identity_relationsh: Legacy import: relationships between legacy identities found during review.
buildertrend_staging_identity_review_run: Legacy import: one identity-review pass over staged data.
buildertrend_staging_observations: Legacy import: evidence observed per staged record, used to detect conflicting captures.
buildertrend_staging_records: Legacy import: one staged legacy record with source ids, raw payload, review and promotion status.
buildertrend_warranty_claim_staging: Legacy import: staged warranty claims awaiting promotion.
{values}_card_fulfillments: Company values board: delivery of physical or digital cards and gifts for approved recognitions.
{values}_pulse_responses: Company values board: one recognition, win or concern tagged with a company value, with review status and visibility.
{values}_pulse_story_replies: Company values board: replies to a story-style post.
{values}_pulse_story_states: Company values board: per-user seen and reaction state for story posts.
compass_project_calendar_events: Events Compass has written to a project's shared calendar, for update and removal.
contact_account_link_events: Audit of linking and unlinking directory people to Compass user accounts.
contract_document_template_versions: Versions of a contract document template.
contract_document_templates: Company contract document templates, by department.
contract_packet_documents: Documents included in a contract packet, in order.
contract_packets: A bundle of contract documents sent for signature, with its e-sign and execution status.
correspondence_attachments: Files attached to project correspondence messages.
correspondence_composition_drafts: In-progress composer state for project correspondence.
correspondence_drafts: Saved draft messages in project correspondence.
correspondence_email_deliveries: Email delivery attempts for correspondence messages.
correspondence_email_events: Provider events (sent, bounced, opened) for correspondence email.
correspondence_email_threads: Mapping between correspondence threads and email threads.
correspondence_messages: Messages in a project correspondence thread.
correspondence_participants: People participating in a correspondence thread.
correspondence_source_messages: Imported historical messages kept as evidence for correspondence.
correspondence_user_state: Per-user read and archive state for correspondence threads.
credit_memos: Customer credit memos with applied and remaining amounts.
custom_dashboards: Dashboards generated by the assistant and saved by users.
customers: Customer companies and individuals (owners/clients), with accounting links.
daily_log_photo_aliases: Maps duplicate or imported photo ids to the canonical daily-log photo.
daily_log_photos: Photos attached to daily logs or a project, with review status and owner/vendor/public visibility flags.
daily_log_task_links: Links between a daily log and the schedule tasks it covers.
daily_logs: One field report for a project and day: work, crew, hours, weather, issues and review status.
email_reply_threads: Reply-tracking threads: the token behind each tracked email and the record it belongs to.
estimate_template_defaults: Default settings applied when an estimate template is used.
estimate_terms_templates: Reusable terms and conditions text for estimates.
feedback_desk_items: Feedback desk work items with lifecycle status and priority.
feedback_maintenance_runs: Runs of the feedback desk's scheduled reconciliation.
feedback_service_health: Health observations for the feedback desk's connected services.
google_auth: A company's workspace connection: encrypted service-account key and delegation settings.
google_calendar_entity_links: Maps Compass records to calendar events Compass created.
google_calendar_events: Cache of events read from users' external calendars.
google_calendar_selections: Which external calendars each user chose to show.
google_project_calendar_acl_members: Unused: planned sharing list for project calendars (see consolidation plan).
google_project_calendar_subscriptions: Unused: planned project calendar subscriptions (see consolidation plan).
google_project_calendars: Older project calendar mapping, read only (see consolidation plan).
google_starred_files: Drive files a user starred in Compass.
goto_inbound_events: Inbound SMS messages with matching and review status.
greeting_card_requests: Greeting cards prepared for approval and sending.
groups: Named groups of people within a company.
inbound_emails: Every imported inbound email with its match status (posted, needs_review, ignored_outbound and so on).
internal_contacts: The company's own staff directory entries.
invoice_credit_allocations: Credit memo amounts applied to invoices.
jarvis_bridge_events: Events exchanged with the external agent bridge.
listening_playlist_track_links: Links between playlist items and provider tracks.
listening_track_links: Provider track references for the listening room.
mcp_api_keys: Hashed API keys with scopes for the MCP and local bridge.
mcp_servers: External MCP servers configured for the assistant.
my_compass_calendar_items: Items Compass has written to a person's app-created calendar.
notification_deliveries: Per-channel delivery attempts (email, SMS, push) for a notification.
notification_events: A notification event and its source record.
notification_preferences: Each person's notification channels, topics, quiet hours and daily-log reminder time.
notification_recipients: Who receives a notification event, with read and dismiss state.
{sales}_bracing_rental_lines: Product sales: equipment lines on a rental.
{sales}_catalog_prices: Product sales: price of each product in a catalog version.
{sales}_order_items: Product sales: items on an order, tied to the catalog version.
{sales}_order_workflows: Product sales: one order and its workflow status, PO link and payment details.
{sales}_products: Product sales: catalog products with SKU and accounting cost code.
organization_calendar_settings: Company work-calendar settings (work days, hours, time zone).
organization_members: Membership of a user in a company, with their role.
organizations: Tenants: building companies, client organizations and the demo company.
owner_project_updates: Owner updates drafted from logs and photos, published or recalled.
project_access_invitations: Invitations for owners, vendors and staff to a project, with email delivery and retry state.
project_budget_applications: Owner pay applications (G702 header): amounts, retainage, deposit applied, status and billing/sync state.
project_change_order_documents: Documents attached to a change order, including the executed copy.
project_change_order_history: Status transitions and edits of a change order.
project_change_order_lines: Cost-coded lines of a change order.
project_change_orders: Change orders with kind, audience, status, e-sign and accounting status.
project_contact_source_links: Links from project contacts to their source records (imports, accounting).
project_contacts: People and companies attached to a project as owner, supplier, subcontractor or internal.
project_contract_budget_adjustments: Manual adjustments to a contract budget revision.
project_contract_budget_lines: Lines of a contract budget revision.
project_contract_budget_revisions: Numbered contract budget revisions (R1, R2...), exactly one current.
project_duplicate_decisions: Reviewed decisions on possible duplicate projects (not duplicate, merged).
project_estimate_acknowledgements: Acknowledgements and acceptance evidence for estimates.
project_estimate_basis_documents: Documents an estimate is based on (plans, specs); protects them from removal.
project_estimate_line_cost_items: Cost items that make up an estimate line.
project_estimate_lines: Estimate lines with quantity, cost, markup, tax and cost code.
project_estimate_report_phases: How estimate lines group into phases on the client report.
project_estimates: Estimates and versions with status, e-sign and accounting status.
project_external_links: Links from a project to records in outside systems.
project_external_resource_grants: Grants that let outside people reach specific external resources for a project.
project_finish_selection_rooms: Rooms used to organize finish selections.
project_follow_ups: Follow-up reminders for clients and leads.
project_job_status_label_conflicts: Custom job-status labels that conflicted during the label migration.
project_job_status_label_keys: Normalized keys that keep custom job-status labels unique per company.
project_members: Membership of a person in a project, with their project role.
project_notes: Internal notes on a project or client.
project_number_aliases: Old or alternate job numbers that still resolve to a project.
project_number_reservations: Reserved job numbers, so a number is never reused.
project_number_review_decisions: Approved exceptions to the job-number format.
project_operations: To-dos, RFQs, purchase orders, pay-application mirrors and accounting handoffs, told apart by source_record_type.
project_profile_audit_events: Before/after audit of project profile changes (job status, numbers, settings).
project_profile_sync_operations: Queued syncs of project profile changes to trackers.
project_registry_removals: Projects removed from the registry view.
project_rfis: Requests for information with status, priority, audience and responses.
project_route_aliases: Redirects from merged projects to the surviving project.
project_saved_views: Personal and shared saved filters for the project hub.
project_selection_procurement_links: Links from selections to the RFQs and POs that procure them.
project_selection_requests: Requests to the owner for a selection decision.
project_template_application_items: Items created when a project template was applied.
project_template_applications: Each application of a template to a project.
project_template_content_items: Content items within a project template module.
project_template_modules: Modules of a project template (schedule, to-dos, documents).
project_templates: Project, estimate and assembly templates with lifecycle and review status.
project_videos: Project videos for owner updates and social publishing.
projects: The project (job) record: number, department, job status, client, site, Drive and calendar links, visibility settings.
role_permission_overrides: Company overrides of a role's feature access levels.
sage_bridge_request_nonces: Accounting bridge: request ids seen recently, to block replays.
sage_bridge_status: Accounting bridge: last heartbeat per on-premises agent.
sage_client_directory_entries: Accounting bridge: client directory rows read from accounting.
sage_client_project_write_operations: Accounting bridge: queued client and job creations for the writer agent.
sage_contact_create_events: Accounting bridge: history of contact-create proposals.
sage_cost_codes: Cost codes from the accounting system.
sage_pay_application_snapshots: Accounting bridge: progress-billing snapshots read from accounting.
sage_pay_application_sync_runs: Accounting bridge: queued and completed pay-application read runs.
sage_square_payment_operations: Card payments: receipt and processing-fee operations queued for accounting, with claim state.
sage_square_webhook_events: Card payments: webhook events received, for idempotency and review.
sage_write_approvals: Approvals required before the bridge writes to accounting.
schedule_baselines: Saved copies of a schedule's dates.
schedule_publications: Published schedule snapshots for owners and vendors.
schedule_task_links: Links from a schedule task to files, RFIs, conversations and to-dos.
schedule_tasks: Schedule tasks with dates, workday duration, status, phase, critical-path flag and confirmation state.
shop_ticket_lines: Labor and machine lines on a shop ticket.
social_post_targets: Accounts a social post is published to.
social_posts: Social media posts drafted or published from projects.
social_project_albums: Project photo albums for social publishing.
staff_message_records: Message desk: phone and text messages for staff, with triage status.
task_dependencies: Dependencies between schedule tasks (FS, SS, FF, SF).
team_permission_overrides: Team grants that raise feature access levels.
vendors: Vendor companies (subcontractors and suppliers), with trade and accounting links.
voice_participants: People in a voice or video room.
voice_realtimekit_meetings: Video meetings created with the real-time video provider.
work_calendar_events: Company work-calendar events (time off, meetings, holidays).
workday_exceptions: Non-working and extra working days for schedules.
youtube_channel_connections: Connected video channels for publishing project videos.
